scope: P1-3 independent genuine-old-library migration and small candidate-semantics review
reviewer_role: independent reviewer for this Claude follow-up; no production implementation or formal repository tests authored
conclusion: passed within the recorded independent scope; no blocking finding

baseline.creation_method: Actual original library and original exported headers; public API business fixture setup; SQL reads only; old Store closed before new-library open; no PRAGMA lowering

migration.only_permitted_existing_row_change: settings.fts_tokenizer_version value; all other settings rows and all 44 original column lists preserved
migration.old_binary_result: E_SCHEMA_VERSION; upgraded database business rows/catalog unchanged

coverage: ASCII-only case folding, Unicode combining characters, CJK, supplementary characters and emoji
AND/OR/NOT shapes compared with existing exact matches() predicate
65536-gram field overflow stays in the safe candidate set
other-owner exact hits and newer nonmatching rows do not consume the one-candidate result

preparation_failure.classification: Independent optional harness used nonexistent AST key after 193 checks; product rejected it correctly. Original source/log retained. v2 uses published children/child syntax. No production changes.

limitations: Independent Linux Debug probes do not substitute for the root full CTest/pytest/ASan gates or future CI.
Migration evidence covers the concrete actual 442 fixture, not arbitrary corrupted databases or simultaneous live old/new binaries.
Preservation is of table columns, typed row content, catalog and public responses, not physical SQLite file bytes; adding derived indexes changes the database file.
The finite candidate corpus is not an exhaustive proof over all possible Unicode strings or query trees; fallback and overflow paths retain the existing candidate-budget/partial semantics.
runtime_files_policy: Do not commit databases, WAL/SHM files, static libraries or probe binaries; deliver source, logs and JSON evidence only.
